versions.content: If a node of the J1939 Network Management module is configured for deferred online state ( J1939NmNode StartUpDelay enabled) , it s NodeCh annels shall enter the sub state ‘Claiming’ of the state ‘Offline’ immediately after the switch from ‘SleepMode’ to ‘NetworkMode’ . The J1939 Network Management module shall report t h is state change to the Basic Software Mode Manager via BswM_J1939Nm_StateChangeNotification (NM_STATE_OFFLINE ) .
